notes: 256VME cells are the physical subarray; do not use logical tile32²=1024 MAC/cycle.
LMUL is register-group capacity, not physical throughput multiplication.
2 operations/MAC throughout; MAC is multiply plus add.
Measured operator rows are synthetic, deterministic I8 data at model-derived geometries, not trained-weight model-part execution.
Q/O, K/V, and gate/up aliases identify same geometry only; do not sum aliases as separately measured calls.
Paired groups retain cohort, exact case and observer mode; do not compare arbitrary cohorts or clean with instrumented records.
Logical interface bytes and ops/byte are not traffic at DRAM/cache/NoC. No physical-memory roofline slope is qualified for these points.
Utilization.value is only architectural VL geometry; physical busy remains null. Conditional source-capacity work fraction is separately named and not busy.
Historical full-model groups contain functional instruction counts and static graph work; never plot as cycles or FPGA utilization.
Policy-fit/holdout and old held_out roles are preserved for display; this analysis performs no fitting or selection.
Native full-model complete-output gates are distinct from source-model quantization quality; historical Spect quality relative error0.006642 remains failed.
